items.title: The Weekly Closeout: NYC bans surveillance pricing, FabFitFun lands in Walmart
items.why: The NYC surveillance pricing ban could limit personalized merchant offers built on card data, so check the rule's scope before building them.
items.summary_ai: New York City banned surveillance pricing, which bars tailoring prices with personal data, while FabFitFun is launching a beauty box in 3,000 Walmart stores.
items.take: The NYC surveillance pricing ban could limit personalized merchant offers built on card data, so check the rule's scope before building them.
